title: Loom application interface and workflow profile v1
description: Declarative interface/workflow data. Target app versions are independent from profile revisions; null explicitly means unknown. Runtime validates renderer and operation registries, finite-state references and matching operation/capability adapters. This schema installs no code, model settings, permissions, hidden provider instructions or request reconstruction.

profile_revision.description: A safe integer representation invariant, independent from the target application's release.

application_id.description: Open identifier vocabulary; no provider-specific branches.

version.description: Original app release identifier or null when unverified/unknown. Never inferred from profile_revision.

status.description: Self-declared mapping evidence status, not a claim of hidden engine parity or measured provider request fidelity.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) provenance URL without whitespace. Runtime URL parsing and rejection of credentials are normative; this contract requires no optional URI format checker.

revision.description: Pinned source commit/release when known; optional does not imply a pin exists.

gaps.description: Explicit visual/workflow/evidence omissions. Missing runtime capabilities are reported separately from actual adapter registrations.

renderer.description: Must name a renderer registered by trusted code. Unknown renderers fail visibly.

actions.description: Unique action IDs. Required actions block activation without their matching adapters; optional actions expose explicit gaps and reject execution.

workflows.description: Unique workflow IDs. State changes occur only after adapter success; runtime validates references, deterministic events, guards and restoration traces.

hexColour.description: Bounded CSS colour syntax, without executable or arbitrary CSS values.

pixels.description: Positive finite width in CSS pixels. No product-policy ceiling; responsive CSS can fit the viewport.

jsonValue.description: Finite JSON-only values. Runtime rejects cycles, functions, accessors, hidden properties, noncanonical/sparse array indices, custom prototypes, undefined, non-finite numbers and symbols before binding/saving.

pointer.description: RFC6901 JSON pointer. Empty explicitly selects the root; ~0 and ~1 escape tilde and slash. Runtime traverses own data fields only, with canonical array indices and no getters.

payloadExpression.description: Pure declarative payload. Missing references fail before effects. No result exists before execution. The caller cannot also supply an imperative payload.

saveExpression.description: Explicit selected-output expression. Non-result bindings are validated/captured before effects. Result selections are checked after adapter success; an invalid selection leaves session state unchanged but external effects cannot be rolled back. Nothing is persisted implicitly, including native requests, callbacks, inputs or full results.

operation.description: Canonical or explicitly extended operation identifier. Runtime rejects unknown operations.

capability.description: Satisfied only by an actual adapter registered for BOTH this capability and this operation.

session.description: Persistence contract exposed as a reusable definition. Runtime replays history against the exact registered profile; a local trace is not a server authorization record. Adapter failures cannot advance this state, though external adapter side effects are not rollbackable by this UI runtime.

definition.description: Exact canonical JSON content identity (object keys sorted by code point, array order preserved). It is a content copy, not a cryptographic hash; must match the registered definition on reload, even when revision and target labels match.

variables.description: Optional additive /1 field. Workflow-scoped variables exactly replay selected receipt updates. Original sessions without variables remain valid.
Only updates named by this transition.save, never automatic request/result capture.

requires.description: Declarative guard: all named capabilities must have actual registered adapters.

save.description: Optional additive /1 field. Values are selected atomically into the current workflow's vars scope after successful adapter execution and JSON validation. Selections use prior vars, not sibling saves from the same transition.
